itinerary: Vancouver (Plaza of Nations → Vancouver Maritime Museum)
Vancouver (Elsje Point or Teatotaler Beach & False Creek)
legs.narrative: Teams began the race at Jack Poole Plaza, where each team received an Express Pass that they could use through the sixth leg. No more than one team could redeem an Express Pass on any given task. From the starting line, teams had to find their next clue outside BC Place. Before the race began, teams flew on floatplanes from Vancouver International Water Airport to Vancouver Harbour Flight Centre and experienced a welcoming ceremony at the starting line by representatives of the Squamish Nation. Squamish hereditary chief Ian Campbell appeared as the Pit Stop greeter during this leg.

tasks.description: In this season's first Roadblock, one team member had to don grizzly bear claws and climb up into BC Place's catwalk. Racers then had to jump from a height of 200 feet on a bungee swing and grab a Pacific salmon to receive their next clue. Erin & Javi used their Express Pass to bypass this task.
After the Roadblock, teams had to travel by Aquabus water taxi to the Vancouver Maritime Museum and find their next clue outside of the museum.

This season's first Detour was a choice between Run It Up or Paddle It Out. In Run It Up, teams had to memorize the single-flag signals of 25 maritime flags and find a boat on a nearby dock, where the captain would randomly shout five signals and teams had to raise the correct flags within two minutes to receive their next clue. Dafina & Saran used their Express Pass to bypass this task. In Paddle It Out, teams had to paddle a va'a outrigger canoe along False Creek to one of six buoys with their next clue. Dylan & Doug used their Express Pass to bypass this task.
After the Detour, teams had to check in at the Pit Stop: the VanDusen Botanical Garden.

itinerary: Vancouver (Vancouver International Airport) → Madrid, Spain (Madrid–Barajas Airport)
Madrid (Aeropuerto T1-T2-T3 Metro Station → Batán Metro Station)
Madrid (Extrem Puro Extremadura & Perro Paco Restaurant or Museo del Prado)
legs.narrative: At the start of this leg, teams were instructed to fly to Madrid, Spain, with teams required to book their plane tickets at Silkway Travel. Once there, teams had to travel by Madrid Metro to Plaza de Toros El Batán to find their next clue.

tasks.description: In this leg's Roadblock, which was a Switchback from season 10, one team member had to participate in a La Tomatina festival and search through a pile of tomatoes for one with a miniature clue – a capsule containing an image of Puerta del Sol – inside it while locals pelted them with tomatoes. Daisha & Dalton used their Express Pass to bypass this task.
After the Roadblock, teams had to find their next clue at Puerta del Sol.

This leg's Detour was a choice between Slice of Ham or Slice of History. In Slice of Ham, teams had to deliver a jamón ibérico to a restaurant, where they had to properly slice 50 grams of ham and prepare a charcuterie board to receive their next clue. Cody & Jaime used their Express Pass to bypass this task. In Slice of History, teams had to find 12 Spanish historical impersonators, who would each say a fact about themselves but not their names, and then match portraits to their names to receive their next clue. Jody & Jenn used their Express Pass to bypass this task.
After the Detour, teams had to check in at the Pit Stop: Plaza de España.

itinerary: Madrid (Madrid–Barajas Airport) → Marrakesh, Morocco (Marrakesh Menara Airport)
legs.narrative: At the start of this leg, teams were instructed to fly to Marrakesh, Morocco. Once there, teams had to travel by taxi to Razani Pottery, which had their next clue.

tasks.description: In this leg's Roadblock, one team member had to smash reject clay jugs until they found their next clue. One of the clues contained a new advantage called Roadside Assistance, which allowed racers to ask their partner for help during a Roadblock up until the fifth leg, and was found by Dafina & Saran.
After the Roadblock, teams had to travel by taxi into the Agafay Desert to their next clue.

This leg's Detour was a choice between Walk or Talk. In Walk, teams had to roll two large tires to a hitching post, fill the tires with alfalfa, and then retrieve two camels to receive their next clue. Anuar & Andrea used their Express Pass to bypass this task. In Talk, teams had to drive a dune buggy through the desert, memorize three sign posts that each contained part of a name for an Amazigh tea, and drive to a camp, where they had to correctly recite the tea before sampling some and receiving their next clue.

After the Detour, teams had to travel by taxi to the Arset El Bilk Garden and find their next clue at Jemaa el-Fnaa. There, teams had to properly stack fruit on a stand to receive their next clue, which directed them to travel on foot to the Pit Stop: the Koutoubia Gardens. Ann-Marie & Riley used their Express Pass to bypass this task.

itinerary: Marrakesh (Association Sidi Yacoub Tannerie) Marrakesh (Rahba Kedima Square & Palais Dar Si Aissa) Marrakesh (Souk Smata) Marrakesh (Souk des Teinturiers)
legs.narrative: At the start of this leg, teams were released in two-minute intervals signaled by two garrabs ringing bells based on the order of their arrival at the previous Pit Stop and were instructed to travel by taxi to Bab Debbagh and find their next clue at the Association Sidi Yacoub Tannerie. The three clue pieces were three tiles with Arabic engravings (مدرسة ابن يوسف) of the name of the Pit Stop: the Ben Youssef Madrasa.

tasks.description: Teams encountered a Scramble and had to complete, in any order, three tasks in Marrakesh's medina quarter related to Moroccan handicrafts to receive three pieces of a clue revealing their next destination. For the task at Rahba Kedima Square entitled Rug Run, teams had to deliver a nine-foot Moroccan rug to the Palais Dar Si Aissa and lay it out on the rooftop to receive a clue piece. For this leg's Roadblock at Souk Smata entitled Slipper Search, one team member had to choose a pair of babouche slippers and search the market for an exact match to receive a clue piece. Dafina & Saran used their Roadside Assistance on this Roadblock. For the task at Souk des Teinturiers entitled Dye 'n Dry, teams had to dye one bundle of yarn dark blue and two yellow to receive a clue piece.

itinerary: Marrakesh (Marrakesh Menara Airport) → Tirana, Albania (Tirana International Airport Nënë Tereza)
legs.narrative: At the start of this leg, teams were instructed to fly to Tirana, Albania. Once there, teams had to search outside of the airport for a marked car with their next clue, which directed them to drive to Turtle Farm Albania.

tasks.description: In this leg's first Roadblock, one team member had to harvest grapes and grind them using a manual grape crusher to produce must, used to make raki, to receive their next clue. Ali & Joanna used their Express Pass to bypass this task. Teams encountered a Driver's Seat at the Roadblock, where the first team to arrive at the board determined how many pounds of must racers had to produce. Michelle & Matt took control of the Driver's Seat and publicly assigned 50 pounds to themselves, Ann-Marie & Riley, and Erin & Javi; 75 pounds to Conner & Garrett, Dafina & Saran, and Daisha & Dalton; and 100 pounds to Ali & Joanna, Anuar & Andrea, and Doug & Dylan.
After the first Roadblock, teams had to drive to Instituti i Artit Kulinar Royal to find their next clue.

In this leg's second Roadblock, one team member had to roll out dough for byrek breakfast pastries to receive their next clue; teams could have the same person do both Roadblocks. Teams encountered a second Driver's Seat at the Roadblock, where the first team to arrive at the board determined how many pastries racers had to roll. Michelle & Matt took control of the Driver's Seat and publicly assigned eight pastries to themselves; twelve pastries to Ann-Marie & Riley, Dafina & Saran, and Doug & Dylan; and sixteen pastries to Ali & Joanna, Anuar & Andrea, Conner & Garrett, Daisha & Dalton, and Erin & Javi.

After the second Roadblock, teams had to drive to Bunk'Art 1 to find their next clue. There, teams had to search the bunker for a marked room, listen to a conversation on a cassette player, transcribe every seventh word, and decode the message to reveal a location – Downtown One – by choosing the first letter of each word to receive their next clue. Teams then had to drive to Downtown One to find their next clue, which directed them to travel on foot to the Pit Stop: Skanderbeg Square.
